item.text: {"explanation":"The implementation keeps permanent records for every accepted ID and sequence. Existing IDs are duplicates only when both sequence and delta match; otherwise they conflict. A new ID conflicts if its sequence is already reserved, is stale if it is below the next unapplied sequence, and is accepted otherwise. After acceptance, all contiguous reserved sequences are applied exactly once. Pending sequences remain sorted and exclude applied entries.","program":"function applies(input){return !!input&&Array.isArray(input.events)}\nfunction solve({config,state,event}){var s=state||{n:1,v:0,a:[]},n=s.n,v=s.v,a=s.a,e=event,i,o,t='accepted';for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i][0]===e.id){o=a[i];t=o[1]===e.seq&&o[2]===e.delta?'duplicate':'conflict';break}if(!o){for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i][1]===e.seq){t='conflict';break}if(t==='accepted'&&e.seq<n)t='stale';if(t==='accepted')a.push([e.id,e.seq,e.delta])}if(t==='accepted')for(;;){o=null;for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i][1]===n){o=a[i];break}if(!o)break;v+=o[2];n++}var p=[];for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i][1]>=n)p.push(a[i][1]);p.sort(function(x,y){return x-y});return{state:{n:n,v:v,a:a},output:{status:t,value:v,next:n,pending:p}}}" }
